name: Data-Tel of Louisiana
old_description: Welcome to Data-Tel of Louisiana, Inc. (Data-Tel) where our business is “connecting your world”. Data-Tel is a corporation registered in the state of Louisiana and operates under Louisiana Contractor License #36386. We are also licensed in the states of Mississippi and Alabama. With a staff of over twenty employees, and an in-house Registered Communication Distribution Designer (RCDD), Data-Tel of Louisiana specializes in structured cabling systems, low voltage systems wiring, outside plant fiber optic and copper design and installation.
about:
Data-Tel of Louisiana, Inc. was established in Walker, Louisiana, by Emily LeBlanc and Bart LeBlanc. The woman-owned, family-operated business has served the Gulf Coast region for over two decades. The company holds a Louisiana Contractor License (#36386) and is also licensed in Mississippi and Alabama.

Data-Tel designs and installs structured cabling systems, low-voltage wiring, and outside-plant fiber optic and copper infrastructure. With a staff of 12 to 22 employees and an in-house Registered Communications Distribution Designer (RCDD), the firm handles design, project management, installation, and maintenance. It installs roughly 1.4 million feet of cable annually and owns cable testers and fiber fusion splicers for on-demand troubleshooting and emergency repairs.

The company serves commercial retail, government, medical, education, financial, and new-construction/renovation markets. Notable projects include the 8th Air Force War Command Center at Barksdale AFB, Louisiana Heart Hospital, North Oaks renovations, New Orleans Convention Center renovations, Broadmoor Elementary School, and wireless infrastructure deployments for East Baton Rouge, Rapides, and St. Tammany parishes.

Data-Tel differentiates itself by completing most wiring conversions overnight to minimize client downtime, offering 24/7 technician response, and providing manufacturer-backed warranties that can extend beyond 25 years. Its technicians maintain BICSI certifications and participate in ongoing manufacturer training, ensuring installations support speeds up to 40 Gbps.

name: DeVine Woodworking
old_description: We’d love to hear about your project. DeVine Woodworking specializes in custom built-ins and furniture designed specifically for your space and lifestyle. We offer a complimentary initial video consultation to discuss your ideas and determine if we’re the right fit.
about:
DeVine Woodworking was founded in 2019 by Travis DeVine in Long Island City, New York. The business operates as a family-owned studio; Travis serves as lead artisan and designer while his wife Chelsea DeVine acts as owner and project manager. Travis’s background includes over a decade of apprenticeship with carpenters, electricians, plumbers, and cabinet builders before launching the venture to create sustainably built, durable pieces that blend mid-century modern and art deco influences.

The studio provides a full design-build service for custom furniture and architectural built-ins. Its in-house capabilities cover project management, 3D rendering, furniture design, carpentry, and installation, allowing the team to take a project from concept through final fit-out. Most fabrication occurs in the company’s New York City woodworking shop, which keeps on-site disruption to a minimum; typical installations range from one day for a single piece to two weeks for large built-ins, with a standard living-room unit taking about four to five days.

DeVine Woodworking serves homeowners, apartment renters, and businesses across New York City, as well as architects and interior designers seeking a fabrication partner. Recent projects include a walnut storage cabinet for a Park Slope apartment, a butcher-block kitchen countertop with custom cabinets in Brooklyn, a Murphy bed for an Alphabet City residence, and built-in bookshelves with integrated LED lighting for various Manhattan apartments.

The founders emphasize a collaborative process that starts with a free phone consultation and a $500 deposit covering an in-person measure, a scaled 3D rendering, and one design revision. By handling design, build, and installation internally, the studio aims to deliver pieces that are tailored to each client’s space and lifestyle, built to last generations.

name: DeWys Manufacturing, Inc
old_description: In 1977, Mark DeWys founded DeWys Manufacturing in a little red barn on his parents’ property in Grand Rapids, MI. A hands-on entrepreneur, Mark first gained experience in the industry while working in a tool-and-die shop owned by
about:
DeWys Manufacturing began in 1977 when Mark DeWys started the company in a small red barn on his parents’ property in Grand Rapids, Michigan. Drawing on experience from his grandfather’s tool-and-die shop, Mark initially produced tubular fireplace inserts and small metal parts. The business relocated to its current Marne, Michigan facility in 1986, and Mark’s brother Jon DeWys joined in 1987, later assuming leadership after Mark’s passing in 1999. The company remains family-owned.

Today DeWys operates as DeWys Metal Solutions, a full-service contract metal manufacturer offering OEM precision sheet metal fabrication, forming and bending, laser cutting, turret punching, robotic and manual welding, machining, powder coating, product development, assembly, and contract manufacturing. The organization comprises six specialized brands—DeWys Manufacturing, DeWys Stainless Solutions, Wyze Designs, ReFab, Shoreline Powder Coating, and American Grower Resource—serving over 160 customers from a campus at 15300 8th Avenue in Marne. The company highlights its use of a fully automated part-sorting robot for laser cutting, noted as the second such installation in the United States.

The company serves industries including medical equipment, food and beverage, agriculture, renewable energy, data centers, retail fixtures, office furniture, fixed seating, material handling, heavy-duty equipment, electrical equipment, and EV charging. Customers range from OEMs requiring precision components to firms seeking complete contract manufacturing solutions.

DeWys emphasizes its family-owned, American-made identity, lean manufacturing principles, and workforce development through DeWys University, established in 2012. The firm has earned recognition on the Fabricator’s FAB 40 list, multiple Best & Brightest workplace awards, and the MMA Small Tier Manufacturer Award.

name: Depco Power Systems
old_description: Depco Power Systems distributes switchgear for defense, mining, telecommunications and oil & gas industries. Switchgear units meet military specifications and are used in power generation and standby applications.
about:
Depco Power Systems is headquartered in Houston, Texas. The company was founded in January 1991 by Tim Felty and Dick Davis in Alvin, Texas, originally operating as Diesel Engine & Parts Co. Tadd Stickler joined the team later that year, becoming a key contributor to the company's growth. In 1993, the business moved to its current 30,000-square-foot facility on Hillsboro Street in Houston, positioned near the Port of Houston.

Depco buys, sells, and rebuilds power generation equipment, including diesel and natural gas generator sets, generator ends (100 kW to 3,000 kW), marine engines and transmissions, power units, transfer switches, radiators, and miscellaneous parts. The Houston facility spans an entire city block and is equipped with a loading dock, forklifts, and three overhead cranes for handling large power units. A multi-step testing and certification process is applied to each unit, and the company maintains a staff of 10 to 49 employees. Depco also offers global shipping, with a proven track record of overnight delivery.

The company serves a range of industries: defense, mining, telecommunications, oil and gas, marine and offshore, data centers, healthcare (hospitals), cryptocurrency mining, grow rooms, and dredging. Customers include commercial and industrial buyers seeking standby, prime, or backup power solutions, as well as sellers of used equipment looking for quick settlement and fair market value.

Depco emphasizes its purpose-built facility, rigorous testing, and responsive in-house service team as differentiators. The Depco Guarantee provides warranty support on certified units, backed by flexible payment terms and 35-plus years of industry expertise. The founders' early focus on supplying used Detroit Diesel parts to dealers nationwide established a conservative, quality-oriented approach that continues to shape the company's operations.

name: Dextronix, Inc.
old_description: Dextronix creates affordable implantable medical devices for the exclusive use in veterinary medicine. The company’s initial focus was on the treatment of heart disease in dogs with permanent implantable pacemaker systems. Dextronix then also offers selected stent and catheter products to treat a variety of problems in cats and dogs. Since 2013 Dextronix expanded into wireless digital diagnostic monitoring equipment with focus on cardiology, airway management and urology.
about:
Dextronix, Inc. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona, with its main office in Portland, Oregon and additional locations in Sacramento and San Diego, California. The company creates affordable implantable medical devices exclusively for veterinary medicine.

Dextronix designs and develops implantable medical devices for veterinary use, including permanent pacemaker systems for dogs, stents and catheters for cats and dogs, and wireless digital diagnostic monitors for cardiology, airway management, and urology. Manufacturing is carried out in France and Germany through partnerships with human medical device manufacturers, such as BS-MTI in France, where core competences include catheter, occluder, balloon, polymer and metal stent fabrication. The company adheres to human medicine quality standards.

Dextronix serves veterinary specialists in cardiology, interventional radiology, surgery, emergency and critical care. Its devices are used by animal clinics and veterinary colleges worldwide for small and large animals, including cats, dogs, horses, and certain exotic animals.

The company was founded to address the lack of affordable implantable medical devices for veterinary use, leveraging human medical device manufacturing standards to provide high-quality, reliable products at lower cost. Dextronix aims to fill the gap where human medical standards are often not available for companion animals.

about:
Founded in 1950 in Danvers, Massachusetts, DiLuigi Foods remains a family-owned operation that has linked tradition with innovation for over seven decades. The company began as a provider of quality meats and has grown into a recognized food manufacturing business serving retail and foodservice channels.

DiLuigi Foods processes beef, chicken, and steak products through SQF-certified facilities. The company maintains an in-house laboratory for rapid raw-material testing and coordinates third-party verification to ensure food safety. A dedicated culinary R&D team develops new products and flavors, conducting extensive taste, texture, color, packaging, and shelf-life testing before market release. Operations span retail and wholesale distribution, with a focus on minimally processed, high-quality meat items.

The company serves retail grocery, foodservice distributors, and restaurant operators. Its product development cycle explicitly reviews restaurant, retail, and foodservice trends to create items that perform in the marketplace. Customers include both retail buyers seeking branded meat products and foodservice operators requiring consistent quality and innovation.

DiLuigi Foods emphasizes its commitment to food safety and quality as its founding principle. The ownership cites the in-house lab, third-party audits, and SQF certification as key differentiators that allow faster, more accurate quality evaluation. Community involvement, including support for local food banks and national philanthropic efforts, is also noted as part of the company's mission since 1950.
